notes.content:
Hey everyone

I’ve been juggling quite a few things lately, including launching the game on another platform, so I haven’t had the chance to add new content recently. That said, I’m still checking bug reports and fixing things as they come in.

Here are a few bugs that got fixed:

notes.title: Cute Cups Update
notes.content:
This is the biggest patch since the release, I worked on many details that will improve everyone's experience while playing. Without forgetting to add even more content!

Not one, not two but THREE new cats
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/2dd2fd40b413cbb9f076f3b11568f0142df75a6a.png
I won't spoil everything on them, but I can't resist showing you the starting weapon of one of them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/dfbd53c7cb571e3c496dae06592d5c088ef2b90d.png
Yes, it's a weapon, and as you would imagine, it's in the damn cute family.

Cats can now break cups
...as they do in real life.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/827fab2da68fdd3864dbc7eb7be8c9025b7e5357.gif

 Instead of the magnet lying around, they are now in cups that spawn at the start of each wave.
 They are easy to break and contain items you can already pick up in-game.
 For those used to chasing the permanent magnets it used to have around the start, they are still there, just in cups now.
 Catcoins that used to spawn on the ground are now in the cups
 Most hearts are still spawning outside of a cup, because, well, if you need hearts, I'm not sure you want to take the time to break the cup first!


Controller shortcuts
Moving in a menu with a controller is always a bit messy without shortcuts. Now it should make things smoother! You can now with a shortcut =>
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/188c8149edc95afc3c5366882b58bfaf2bc5bc7c.png

 Close popup
 Choose your upgrade
 Reroll
 show the codex
 Navigate between the different tabs in the main menu
 Access some elements in the different tabs with just a button


Finally, Codex in-game!
The Codex was added to help people understand the weapon's paths. After implementing, you legitimately asked for it to be available in-game.  You can now access it when you level up!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/bfd893bd321605df24ff26e3900755dcb170280c.gif
I also improved how the codex generally works:

 Codex shows the family
 Codex shows differently the items you finished or not (light yellow or full yellow)
 Items in the Codex are now grouped by families
 Automatically show the item you have selected
 Highlight (with blue selector) the choices you have in the current level up


Achievements
I had to rework the whole achievement system on Steam.

So don't be surprised when you'll launch the game that a lot of new achievements will trigger, it's mostly just changes on how I track achievements on Steam. Your progress in the game didn't change at all.

I sadly couldn't have more than 100 achievements on Steam. It's a limitation most games have; you have to have it unlocked by Steam, and there's nothing I can do to force it.
I didn't know the existence of this limit, and my game has ALREADY more than 100 achievements in-game. Why that much, for example, every cat has 5 achievements: unlocking, killing 3 bosses, finishing a normal game, finishing hard mode, and finishing bargaining.
I packed most achievements in one for Steam, for example, instead of having 1 achievement per cat for finishing a mode, I now have only one for every 5 cats finishing a mode.
I planned everything, and I should not remove any more achievements on Steam after this patch. But adding, for sure! More cats and weapons are still coming!

I also improved the achievements tabs, it now shows more information about numeric achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/d862400344374f8222e379cba24ad1785f3e95d5.gif

Change
New family, Felin, (paw and hair are now Felin's family)

General improve

 Added a boss animation (every boss is now announced)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/3be299dd82fb4610a6706ae6bf6fef73c3d06dea.gif
 The sparks around pick-up items are now all different to help identify which one it is.
 Catcoins now move like the other items
 Added some tips on the ground instead of the same message every game (only 6 for now, but more are coming!)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/8deb72eb03812670a56e5a5f8cad7e94850f75e3.png
 Added image to better show what the bars are about (like a little cardbox for the cardbox bar)
 Reroll now removes the previous choices from the new selection. It's always annoying to use a reroll and have everything back. Only works if you have more items available in the pool.
 Now, when killing a crab, you have a small explanation of what the bonus is about
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/ed377be3c2afd362abcd3ce21d40ff51d6dee468.gif
 Onomatopoeias have been added (can be turned off), like the "crack" + some actions now leave a mark on the world (like breaking a mug). You can see an example of both on the above GIF when the cat breaks the mug.



Bugs elimination

 When using the controller, the wrong family could have the +1 in a rare case
 Bigger Hearts achievement's image was not correctly affiché (it had a typo since day one, I think haha)
 The bigger heart achievement was given too early
 The big laser now targets where the cat is aiming
 Fixed some achievements typo
 [UI] Added some padding in the cat descriptions so they don’t stick to the edge.
 One of the last evolutions of elastic was spawning the wrong color of elastic (one was blue instead of red)
 The big crab wasn't affected by the damage reduction


Once again, thanks to everyone for playing Kitty's Last Adventure, commenting, and taking the time to give me feedback.

notes.title: What to expect next?
notes.content:
It’s hard to believe it’s been only 3 months since the release! The pace has been intense, and here’s a quick recap of what’s been added so far:


 Quality of Life improvements, including a revamped level-up screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/3b64c6612bb6a7f976e2ec258357f2465b6eeeaf.gif
 Balancing adjustments, such as the update to the normal world boss.
 The Codex has been introduced, making it easier to understand how the weapon works.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/3ed012be34b1f962e70622252f8c45a71bb8cc28.gif
 A brand-new world with a fresh system and replayability for the cats already in the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/bb3a5adb0477d43df0f5ab9d7faf8b010007b6fd.gif
 3 new cats, bringing the total number of weapons to 11, with 28 final evolutions!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/91f9228dc3879734d076eb3e5bf2ae8a0d8515eb.png

The feedback has been incredibly positive, and I want to thank you all for your support during Early Access. There’s still a lot of work ahead, with the next focus being adding more cats and weapons!

Next update
The upcoming Christmas-themed update will introduce a new cat Kittree.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/6360728dc31b3fc7042561e1eacb76079d155416.gif


What’s next? Here’s a glimpse:

 More classic cats—some of which are already designed! The ratio of special cats to classic ones is a bit unbalanced right now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866873/eb00d534eafb5d92e3a70fc38d181b1805d3ce94.png
 New weapons without new cats, simply increasing the total weapon pool in the game.
 Improving the early game by making weapons from the first three unlockable cats available earlier. This way, while discovering and testing new cats, you’ll also have the chance to try weapons you haven’t unlocked yet! Noxy is the first new weapon you can currently unlock, and it’s only available after finishing the game!
 Meta progression: Adding levels to existing options or introducing entirely new ones.
 New difficulty levels with more exciting options. The goal is to introduce more variety in runs (boss waves, new enemies, etc.). Currently limited to 5, but eventually, it will go up to 15, unlocking the final world: Serenity.
 More QoL improvements and balancing, including the addition of the Codex in-level and changes to weapon families!


There’s so much more to come, and I appreciate you being part of this journey. Stay tuned, and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Final World Boss Update
notes.content:
In this update, I’ve made significant changes to the final boss fight to make the progression clearer and more enjoyable, while also adjusting the balance.

Main changes:

Damage mechanic rework
The boss is now invulnerable at the start of the fight. His health is no longer tied to the objects he protects. He will appear invulnerable, without a health bar, and your shots won’t affect him until the objects are destroyed. Once the objects are eliminated, he becomes vulnerable, with a white health bar indicating that he can be attacked.

Improved readability and difficulty
The boss will only drool during the final phase of the fight, making this stage less punishing but still challenging. He will be more aggressive by changing direction more frequently and slowing down before attacking at the end of his rushes.

New final health bar
The boss's final health bar has been increased to provide better feedback during the vulnerability phase. You’ll see your attacks' impact more clearly, preventing frustration from an overly abrupt ending.

Thank you to all the streamers and players for your feedback and suggestions!

The next content update will be released in less than two weeks, featuring new cats, weapons, and meta-progression!

-Smoothed the camera
-I keep track of the last cat you used

Small changes, but the demo is not here for long so I prefer to do the most important changes as fast as possible.

Woum.

notes.title: From playtest to demo Patchnote
notes.content:
THanks again everyone that took the time to give my feedbacks during the playtest, here's the patch note:

Gameplay

 Added a boss death animation
 Added Magnet that collects every coin
 Change the feather weapon so that the projectile is further away from the player
 Ghosts are slower


UI

 Added arrows to the selected element when using a controller
 Better detection of the button using the mouse
 Display the objective for the last wave
 Better support for wider screens
 Added some feedback sounds when clicking on the UI
 Better hp bar for the boss
 Different background for the evolve and final evolve choice


Bug

 Correction of some z-index order
 The hit sound is now louder
 Optimization of the code when you collect coins

notes.title: Announcement: Playtests are over, it's time for the demo!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I want to sincerely thank everyone who took part in the playtests. There were so many of you who played and shared your feedback, and it has been incredibly valuable to me.

Kitty's Last Adventure is now stable and I am pleased to announce that the demo is now available! Here’s what you can explore in this version:

 3 cats instead of 1 (and more to come!)
 1 world (7 in the final version)
 6 different weapons and 10 evolutions (and more to come!)
 1 boss
 10 different families bonus (and, yeah, you guessed it more to come!)

I invite you to try out the demo and continue sharing your experience. If you have any questions or need more information, I’d be glad to answer them on the community forum.

Thank you again for your support and enthusiasm!
